question: Do the cited finite modular-covariance and coefficient identities establish a geometric horizon action and uniquely select the entropy/EH normalization in the Dorau-Much bridge?
kills: finite diagonal K=g(L) alone identifies a geometric local horizon action
the variational factor 1/2 alone selects the EH coefficient k=c3/2

analytic_conditional_results: Assuming the actual E8 level-1 lattice conformal vacuum net and common geometric modular action, the localized Cartan Weyl orbit obeys Longo's half-line current relative-entropy formula and maps to the scalar Dorau-Much horizon-flux integrand under x=-U, h(x)=sqrt(2)phi(-x). This is a theorem-based conditional argument, not checker-executed and not a four-dimensional area-response derivation.
scope: Finite modular-covariance checks and a conditional local Cartan-current bridge. The normalization non-identifiability argument applies to the abstract class of normalized fixed-background matter observations; it does not prove multiple admissible realizations of the specified original profile-free gravitational functional.
original_source_scope_correction: As established by original-source-functional-audit-20261013 section D, adding lambdaQ[g] changes the specified profile-free zeta/residue functional and is not automatically an admissible original TFPT source. The missing original task is selection of its off-shell operator/domain/reference/metric family and gluing normalization; no arbitrary counterterm is proposed.
summary_de: Die endlichen Kommutatoridentitäten liefern noch keinen geometrischen Horizont-Boost. Unter dem tatsächlichen E8-Level-1-Vakuumnetz und passender Modularwirkung besteht eine bedingte Cartan-Strom-/Energieflussbrücke. Normierte Materiedaten allein lassen in einer abstrakten Beobachtungsklasse die Flächennormierung offen. Das beweist keine Mehrdeutigkeit des festgelegten ursprünglichen profile-free Funktionals: dessen vollständige metrische Quellenfamilie muss aus den Originalprinzipien folgen.
summary_en: The finite commutator identities do not establish a geometric horizon boost. Under an actual E8 level-1 vacuum net and matching modular action there is a conditional Cartan-current/energy-flux bridge. Normalized matter observations leave area normalization undetermined in an abstract observation class. This does not prove nonuniqueness of the specified original profile-free functional: its full metric source family must follow from the original principles.
